subject: Packlight pilot: temporary PO deferral & onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Ethan Pierce <ethan.pierce@packlight.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Packlight Finance <finance@packlight.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Packlight pilot: temporary PO deferral & onboarding checklist

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the quick demo today. We’re excited to kick off the 30-day integration pilot with Redwood; engineering wants to start this Monday. One hiccup on our side: Packlight’s procurement team can’t issue a PO before the pilot start date due to a quarterly cycle lock.

Is Redwood able to onboard Packlight on an invoice-first basis for the first month (no PO) provided we supply the standard onboarding evidence (W9, bank remit, and commercial insurance)? We can accept an invoice cap (suggested $5,000) for the trial and agree to standard net-30 payment terms.

Attached: packlight_onboarding_form.pdf (completed).

If there’s a short exception process or an approval form we should fill, point me there and we’ll return everything by EOD.

Regards,
Ethan Pierce
Head of BizOps, Packlight Solutions
[Attachment: packlight_onboarding_form.pdf]
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Pierce <ethan.pierce@packlight.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packlight pilot: temporary PO deferral & onboarding checklist

Hi Ethan —

Welcome — glad the demo landed well. We can do a short-term PO deferral for pilots, but we need a few guardrails to keep finance and procurement comfortable. Proposed minimal controls: 

- Invoice-only onboarding for up to 30 days (one billing cycle), capped at $5,000 for the pilot.
- Required evidence: completed onboarding form (you attached), W9, remit details, and proof of commercial insurance.
- Invoices must be tagged with deal id DEAL-7381 and routed to finance@redwood.com; procurement will retroactively document the exception.
- We’ll run a light risk check (no SOC2 required for pilots under $10k, but procurement may request additional docs if any third-party data processing is involved).

I’ve attached a short SOW draft to capture trial scope and billing contact — Marissa, can you confirm whether finance is ok with the cap/net-30? Karthik/Rishi, can procurement sign off on the temporary exception workflow below?

Next steps for Packlight: return W9 and remit info (you mentioned you have those) and confirm invoice contact. Once finance confirms, I’ll submit the procurement exception form and we’ll be good to start.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_draft_stephanie.docx]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-02T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packlight pilot: temporary PO deferral & onboarding checklist

Stephanie / team —

Thanks — quick questions from procurement before I sign off on an exception: 

1) Confirm whether Packlight will process any customer data during the integration (PII/PHI). If yes, we need a basic data map and subprocessor list.
2) Confirm Packlight's EIN and W9 (Ethan attached, but we need a scanned W9 in PDF).
3) We’ll permit a 30-day invoice-only pilot with a $5k cap under these conditions: a) entry into our procurement_exception queue, b) invoice tagging as Stephanie noted, c) operations holdback (we reserve right to pause access if invoices are overdue beyond net-45).

Operational flow I propose: 
- Marissa confirms finance acceptance of the cap/net-30.
- I submit a formal procurement exception ticket referencing DEAL-7381 and attach the onboarding form + W9.
- Legal will not require a full contract amendment for one 30-day pilot; SOW doc is sufficient.

Marissa — please share the finance routing and the contact who will accept invoices for Packlight. I’ll file the exception once we have W9 + finance route.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear notes. Confirming the following from Packlight: 

- No customer PII or PHI will be processed during the pilot (it's purely API connectivity and telemetry).
- Attached: packlight_W9.pdf and a scanned remit page.
- We accept the $5,000 cap and net-30 terms for the trial.
- Billing contact: Lydia Chen, finance@packlight.com. Please route invoices there and cc ethan.pierce@packlight.com.

I’ve attached the completed onboarding form and the W9. Let me know if you need anything else — we can also sign the short SOW draft if that helps speed processing.

Best,
Ethan

Date: 2028-03-03T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Packlight pilot: temporary PO deferral & onboarding checklist

Team —

Finance reviewed Packlight’s submitted W9 and onboarding form. We can accept invoice-only onboarding for one invoice cycle (30 days) under the $5,000 cap and net-30 terms. Routing details below: 

- Send invoices to: accounts-payable@redwood.com with subject line: "Invoice — Packlight — DEAL-7381" and cc finance@packlight.com.
- Payment terms: net-30; late payment holdback threshold at net-45 (ops may suspend access if unpaid).
- Please attach invoice PDF and reference SOW_draft_stephanie.docx where applicable.

I created the deal in HubSpot and linked it here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7381. I’ll mark the deal stage "Pilot - Invoice-only approved" and confirm when procurement exception is filed.

Stephanie — with this confirmation, please submit the procurement exception form (https://docs.redwood.com/internal/procurement/exception-form) and loop legal only if the pilot expands beyond the initial invoice or surpasses $10k.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Action: deal created in HubSpot, finance routing confirmed]
